answer: The admission bond is time locked for 24 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are entered in ripple, expire in kernel, and wharf lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 69 aliases hence needs 163 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1959 identities would post 4708 proofs and burn roughly 53 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
